name: Book and Volume
author: Nick Montfort; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
description: A sysadmin in a sprawling tech city, paged all night long. A satire of the always-on workplace. Text adventure in English (Nick Montfort, 2005). Non-commercial licence. Type if-book-and-volume in the Terminal or tap the icon.
